highlights.text: Threatened Aasif Khan with 'Tamiz Mein Reh, Maar Dunga' during the captaincy task.
Went viral for his quirky definitions of Gen Z dating terms 'situationship' and 'benching'.
Received public support from Arijit Singh, who called him 'Apna Rockstar'.
Explained his dramatic house behavior by stating 'It's part of my game'.
Was called out by Amrapali Dubey for bringing negative energy to the house.
Nearly got into a physical altercation with Aasif Khan during a heated captaincy task.
Unnerved housemates with an 'Oscar-level' performance, asserting 'main normal insaan nahi hoon'.
Spurred singer Arijit Singh to watch Bigg Boss for the first time ever in support of him.
Engaged in a clash with Yung DSA during the episode.
Got into an escalating fight with Yung DSA during the first captaincy task.
Drew comparisons from viewers and former contestant Shalin Bhanot.
Engaged in a heated argument with Yung DSA after mimicking him and got into a verbal spat with Kanika Mann.
